purpose: Prevent nominally remote jobs from being recommended when mandatory working hours are impractical from Slovakia.

rules.when: remote role has flexible/asynchronous hours or no mandatory foreign shift
mandatory working window substantially overlaps 07:00-19:00 Europe/Bratislava
mandatory foreign hours require regular work after 22:00 Bratislava time but still allow at least 4 hours overlap before 22:00
mandatory schedule is predominantly 22:00-06:00 Europe/Bratislava or explicitly requires a US/Americas shift with no flexible alternative
remote role references timezone/shift availability but exact required hours cannot be verified
